proofs.text: Open the regulated fixture, whose payload names a git host, and open `RULE-1`; verify the spec path is a link whose address begins `https://github.com/acme/ledger/blob/` and that the approval file `RULE-1.1a2b3c4d.jane-doe.json` is a link too. Open the solo fixture, which names no remote, and open `RULE-1`; verify the screen holds zero links and still shows the text `specs/auth/login.md`

rule_text: Where the payload names a git host the page can address, the spec file, the record and each approval file are links to that host at the payload's commit; where it names no remote the same paths stay plain text and nothing on the screen is a link

tests.body:
def test_the_rule_screen_links_to_the_git_host(browser, tmp_path):
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload_named('regulated'))
    page.click('[data-act="feature"][data-feature="login"]')
    page.click('.rule[data-rule="RULE-1"]')
    href = page.get_attribute('a[href*="specs/auth/login.md"]', 'href')
    assert href.startswith('https://github.com/acme/ledger/blob/')
    assert page.query_selector('a[href*="RULE-1.1a2b3c4d.jane-doe.json"]')
    page.close()
tests.name: test_a_rule_with_no_remote_has_no_links
